description: Defines the in-memory high-level intermediate representation of shader code as a hierarchy of node classes, including various node types such as expressions, statements, and control flow constructs, used in shader compilation and parsing.

classes.name: TIntermNode
classes.description: Base class for all shader intermediate nodes, providing traversal, copying, and child management.

classes.name: TIntermTyped
classes.description: Derived from TIntermNode, adds type information and constant folding capabilities.

classes.name: TIntermLoop
classes.description: Represents loop constructs (for, while, do-while) with initialization, condition, expression, and body.

classes.name: TIntermBranch
classes.description: Represents control flow statements like break, continue, return, and kill.

classes.name: TIntermSymbol
classes.description: Represents variable symbols in the shader code, including variables and interface block instances.

classes.name: TIntermExpression
classes.description: Represents typed expressions that are not just symbols.

classes.name: TIntermConstantUnion
classes.description: Represents constant values, supports folding and constant evaluation.

classes.name: TIntermOperator
classes.description: Base class for nodes that hold operators, including unary, binary, and function calls.

classes.name: TIntermSwizzle
classes.description: Represents vector swizzle operations.

classes.name: TIntermBinary
classes.description: Represents binary operations like addition, multiplication, etc.

classes.name: TIntermUnary
classes.description: Represents unary operations.

classes.name: TIntermAggregate
classes.description: Represents function calls and list of statements or arguments.

classes.name: TIntermBlock
classes.description: Represents a block of statements or declarations.

classes.name: TIntermFunctionPrototype
classes.description: Represents function prototype declarations.

classes.name: TIntermFunctionDefinition
classes.description: Represents function definitions with prototype and body.

classes.name: TIntermDeclaration
classes.description: Represents variable and struct declarations.

classes.name: TIntermGlobalQualifierDeclaration
classes.description: Represents declarations for invariance or qualifiers.

classes.name: TIntermTernary
classes.description: Represents ternary conditional expressions.

classes.name: TIntermIfElse
classes.description: Represents if-else control flow.

classes.name: TIntermSwitch
classes.description: Represents switch statements.

classes.name: TIntermCase
classes.description: Represents case labels in switch statements.

classes.name: TIntermPreprocessorDirective
classes.description: Represents preprocessor directives like #ifdef, #define.
